reason: It's not opening until next year and there are no reviews or photos of how clean it is, so I'm not paying a membership for something I can't check. With shift work and a drive, I wouldn't get my money's worth from a monthly plan anyway.
objection: I have no way to know how clean it is or how they sanitize toys, and a play space full of toddlers and babies putting things in their mouths is exactly what I check first. The drive and gas on top of that makes it hard to justify.
would_change_my_mind: Solid reviews from other parents after it opens, a posted cleaning routine I can see for myself, and a one-time drop-in at $12 that lets me try it before any membership.
